_note: Precast bio-lime blocks for NON-STRUCTURAL interior partitions, keyed between treated bamboo posts with a head plate (rock/BIO_MATERIALS.md). Values from the literature review (Sep 2026); UNSOURCED marked. Commercial systems glue blocks with ~3 mm lime adhesive; ours key between posts, which keeps them within IRC Appendix BL's 'infill between framing' scope.

hemp_lime.name: hemp-lime block
hemp_lime.mix: hemp 1 : binder 1.8-2.2 : water 2.5-3 by mass; binder 60-70% CL90 lime + 30-40% ground fired brick (our kiln rejects: best pozzolan in PMC7664188)
hemp_lime.src: IsoHemp TDS 2025, Hemplith TDS, Tradical TDS, PMC12608674, PMC7664188, Walker 2014, Arehart 2020; price benchmark IsoHemp 20 cm EUR 81/m2; our sell price UNSOURCED

husk_lime.name: rice-husk-lime block
husk_lime.mix: husk soaked 24 h in lime water; husk 1 : binder 1.5-2 : water ~1.2-1.8; binder ~50% CL90 + 30% rice-husk ash from a SEPARATE <=700 C burn (amorphous by XRD) + 20% NHL 3.5; pressed 0.3-1 MPa
husk_lime.src: Chabannes 2014/2016 (0.33 MPa at 60 d, 640 kg/m3, lambda 0.10-0.14), RHC hollow blocks T&F 2025 (MBV 3.27), lime-RHA mortars KEM 517; flexural and CO2 UNSOURCED

posts._note: treated whole bamboo (borate + oil heat), dry, visible, replaceable; blocks tongue-and-groove into slotted posts; ties 4-5 per m2 per IsoHemp/Hemplith practice

_lateral_src: IBC 1607.15: interior partitions over 6 ft resist 5 psf; ASCE 7 13.5.8 bracing; SDC D sites (NE Arkansas) need an engineer
fixings: IsoHemp: 8x80 wood screw 15 kg, 10x80 25 kg, chemical anchor 50 kg; cabinets on embedded nailers or through-bolts
